main_body: A fenced farm plot: a wooden post-and-rail fence enclosing rows of crops (wheat, greens, cabbages, sprouts) seen from above on a grey ground
top_band: Fence rails at x=55 rows 0-3 are light tan (L=181 then 131), but these are thin 2-4 px rails and the crop field is a flat plan view; there is no front face below the top
evidence: The main body is the crop field, which is drawn as a flat top-down plan of crop rows with no south front face. The fence is a ring of posts and rails with only 2-3 px light rail faces and the side fence is drawn as vertical elevation strips. This is not an open frame or rack with beams showing top faces and legs. The drawing reads as a top-down plan, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The crops have good texture, with multi-tone greens, wheat speckle and soil grain, and the outlines are tinted dark brown or dark green (0% neutral). The median is only 6 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and the 27 distinct colours are below their 40 and 38. Large areas of plain grey ground and fence rails are low in information, so tile density is much lower than the references.
